description:
What does the future of product growth and scale look like across gaming and industry? In Episode 6 of the Industry Partner Podcast, we’re joined by Unity’s SVP of Product, Adam Smith!

In this episode, we discuss insights on Unity’s product growth and scale across games and industry to highlight the opportunities it creates for our developers, partners, and platform impact.

👉 Interested in becoming a Unity Industry Partner? Head over to: https://on.unity.com/UnityPartners
title: Product Growth & Scale | The Unity Industry Partner Podcast

author: Unity
description:
In this quick Unity 6 tip, you'll learn how to use Unity MCP and UI Toolkit to quickly build a placeholder UI. 

Connect your AI agent to the Unity MCP server, then prompt it to generate a main menu, such as three buttons with a semi-transparent background, right in your scene. From there, add a script to connect the button logic, and you've got a basic menu ready for your team to restyle later. 

🔗 Learn more about UI Toolkit: https://on.unity.com/UIToolkit_Documentation
title: Build a mockup UI with Unity MCP
